title: Fix dark mode toggle not affecting layout
description: ThemeProvider.tsx only toggles the .light class and never adds .dark. globals.css has no [data-theme="dark"] block. After clicking the toggle, <html data-theme="dark"> but the dashboard layout stays light. Apply .dark and add dark atmosphere variables.

classification.rationale: Classified as SIMPLE complexity. Direct delegation: single domain, no cross-cutting impact. Required agents (4): backend, frontend, qa, memory_engineer.
